newsitem.title: USA: Washington Homes settles with IRS, sees Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Washington Homes settles with IRS, sees Q3 charge.

text.p: Washington Homes Inc said it has settled all outstanding issues covering tax returns for fiscal years 1992 through 1994 with the Internal Revenue Service and expects to record an extraordinary charge of about $400,000 or $0.05 per share in its third quarter as a result.
The company said the agreement is subject to approval by the IRS District Director.

As previously announced, the IRS raised issues primarily related to the comopany's recapitalization in 1992 and 1993, including a gain of $20 million on debt forgiveness, which the company treated as non-taxable under the provisions of Section 108 of the Internal Revenue Code.
